comments.body: Operator decision recorded 2026-08-23: recommendation #2 is approved for preparation only. Build and validate the immutable-manifest, backup/restore, local candidate, semantic/authorship parity, epoch-refusal, rollback, and quiet-window runbook package. Do not pause writers, freeze/publish a production lease, delete Jira data, or rewrite/push the authoritative tickets history. Stop and notify the operator when every preparation gate passes and the quiet window can be scheduled. The separate execution ticket is synonymous-senatorial-cuscus and depends on this ticket.

compiled_state.description:
## Context

The read-only RCA on absurd-zoometric-bobwhite proved that six markerless reconciler echo bodies on three tickets account for a conservative 760 excess COMMENT events / 18,496,834 bytes plus 229,222,450 repeated bytes inside active and retired snapshots. The deployed comment-id and marker fixes converged; no later target-body COMMENT exists through the incident tip. The retained artifacts remain reachable.

This ticket is PREPARATION ONLY. It may add and test no-push tooling, produce local disposable rewrite candidates, and rehearse restore/refusal behavior. It must not pause writers, publish a lease, force-update tickets, delete Jira comments, or mutate the authoritative tracker. A separate blocked execution ticket owns the quiet window and requires fresh operator approval.

## Correct semantic oracle

Removing echoes necessarily changes reduced state. The permitted ticket-state delta is only the removal of immutable-manifest-enumerated reconciler echo copies. For each of the six incident groups, exactly one Jira-identity-backed local echo survives. Every non-candidate comment, field, link, status, attestation, and audit record remains equivalent. Retained event bytes and signatures remain byte-identical.

The incident seed is the exact tuple of ticket id and body SHA-256:

- 8625-7bea-67db-4cdc: 2a28832f8d7fdb3bbadf4557d163037c31fb6bc32693965c42aa18629ef7de5e, c39cb4843535b2c26790137988010500e53d3dcce3098d315d6ea20f7e00c7e4, eacbefb8d54080f1217c70dc4be4641d20a25b32f88fb42ff5b2a2efb2e64dab
- 9305-b42c-3262-4c58: d429bb0c7d590613d15e2f3f54ed0366143760ca14df0412d14d9bbcaeff6ada, fe854c5c4a276fd5a1a92132c3a9598d3828bfa687d6a23fd75a8afc06e0397b
- e27c-5a20-cd13-43b2: 45f2497fe6298f1172575407f534a63a2dc0825b54c51f29b40b1470f6a73735

Counts and paths are never hardcoded as authority; they are re-enumerated at the frozen execution tip. A candidate must also be a COMMENT authored by env/author reconciler, carry a Jira comment id, and match its ticket/hash tuple.

Every COMMENT whose timestamp is a current bridge comment_ids key is protected. Every real mapped Jira id is a survivor constraint; the unknown-id sentinel is protected provenance, never treated as an id. A complete fresh Jira inventory must show exactly one live id for each target body and a matching local event. Multiple live copies, no match, multiple conflicting mapped ids, incomplete pagination, or any envelope/body drift refuses. If one live Jira id was imported more than once locally, retain one manifest-selected event for that same identity; age alone never chooses the identity.

Snapshots are derived state, not disposable audit data. Each active and retired target snapshot is transformed only by removing manifest target comment entries, target source UUIDs, and their authorship-ledger rows, with summary counts recomputed. All other snapshot fields and all non-target blobs remain identical.

## Plan

1. Add an incident-specific manifest builder. It requires a clean fresh unfiltered, non-promisor tickets clone; an exact source tip; a verified off-repo backup manifest; and complete read-only Jira inventories with reported totals. It snapshots remote heads/tags before and after, refuses movement, and emits canonical JSON containing every target path, UUID, HLC, event blob/hash, Jira id, survivor, snapshot blob transformation, bridge-map constraint, expected state delta, source tip, and manifest digest.
2. Reuse prepare_reclaim_backup.py for the complete bundle, remote-ref census, off-repo path refusal, bundle verification, and throwaway restore proof. Do not weaken or duplicate those gates.
3. Add a dry-run-only stock-Git rewriter. It has no push path. It consumes only the immutable manifest, removes the exact non-survivor COMMENT paths across their active/retired names, rewrites only enumerated snapshot blobs, adds a fresh epoch to the final store-compat tree, and creates a local output ref. Any manifest, blob-sharing, source-tip, remote-ref, or expected-old-content mismatch fails before producing a candidate.
4. Emit an old-to-new commit map and verify topology/identity. Commit and merge counts remain equal; changed paths at every mapped commit are limited to manifest event/snapshot paths plus the final store-compat epoch. Retained event UUID/content/signature and normalized authorship verdict multisets remain equal. Removed UUID/ledger deltas equal the manifest exactly.
5. Replay the full store before/after. All unaffected tickets are identical. For the three targets, normalized state is identical after subtracting only the enumerated echo comments. Bridge bindings/comment_ids are byte-identical, one live Jira-backed echo remains per group, fsck is clean, and no snapshot cites a removed UUID.
6. Rehearse on synthetic real Git repositories: active/retired events, many snapshot generations, duplicate imports of one Jira id, a mapped newest survivor, unknown-id sentinels, partial Jira pagination, ambiguous live copies, moving refs, shared blobs, dirty/shallow/promisor clones, interrupted/retried local rewrite, bundle restore, exact rollback, and stale pre-epoch writer refusal at both union sites. Instrument Git calls to prove no push or remote update occurs.
7. Add a quiet-window runbook that reuses passive-managerial-urson: direct quiescence proofs for reconcile/review-bot/MCP/host/scheduled writers; exact deployed-runtime identity; no fixed waits; frozen lease; fresh unfiltered clone; independently restored bundle; local parity gates; exact force-with-lease only after separate approval; old-tip non-resurrection; persistent-writer recloning; and a rehearsed second-window rollback. The runbook stops before activation in this ticket.
8. Report pack, logical checkout, allocated checkout, file/slack, Git-directory, and whole-clone before/after as observations. tracker-footprint remains opt-in, read-only, unscheduled, non-gating, and threshold-free.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Manifest generation is deterministic at one frozen tip, enumerates only the six incident groups, protects bridge mappings/source comments, proves complete Jira input before selection, and refuses every ambiguity or stale input.
- [ ] The local rewrite changes only manifest COMMENT/snapshot material plus the new epoch, keeps exactly one live-Jira-identity echo per group, and preserves all unrelated reduced state and retained event bytes.
- [ ] Active and retired snapshots, source UUID lists, and authorship ledgers are transformed consistently; full replay, fsck, and normalized retained-authorship parity pass.
- [ ] A complete off-repo bundle is created and independently restored before any candidate; exact rollback and stale-writer refusal are proven in synthetic real-Git rehearsal.
- [ ] The implementation contains no push/remote-update path, and tests prove the authoritative remote and source ref remain unchanged.
- [ ] The operator runbook includes direct quiescence, runtime identity, exact lease, re-clone, non-resurrection, rollback, and post-read verification, and explicitly requires a new approval before activation.
- [ ] Real-store read-only dry-run evidence re-enumerates expected/reclaimed bytes at its observed tip without treating the historical 247,719,284-byte estimate as a pack/allocation result.
- [ ] Focused tests, make lint, make typecheck, and the project test gate pass.
